issues.issue: The Statement of Activities (p2) lists Miscellaneous 2,814,097 under General Receipts, not under program Fees, Fines and Charges for Services (1,569,409 = Licenses 167,774 + Charges 189,645 + Offices 1,211,990). About 75% of the line is Self-Funded Insurance Fund receipts (2,109,308, p20), which are internal insurance premium contributions and not clearly charges for services. The remaining ~705,000 (General Fund 526,024, Road 82,868, ARPA 41,775, Visitors 54,144, etc.) is unexplained. The category is defensible but questionable; the same applies to detail[115] (Self-Funded Insurance 'Miscellaneous').

On p4, the Inheritance Fund column shows that 796,948 of the combined Taxes line is inheritance tax, and detail[51] records it as inheritance tax. The line could have been partly split (inheritance tax 796,948 vs. the unlabeled remainder) with split_from. Keeping it unlabeled is defensible because the column is inferred from the fund name.

The category rules map noxious weed control to natural resources/conservation. The extractor used streets/highways so it ties to the p4 Public Works function, and marked the line for review. This is a judgment call.

These negative treasurer-commission lines (also detail[65] -390 on p8 and detail[103] -105 on p17) are coded as intergovernmental homestead aid. The governmental funds statement (p4) puts the -74 on its Charges for Services row and the -390 and -105 on its Miscellaneous row. They are commissions withheld rather than state aid, so the category is questionable. The amounts are small.

A county visitors' promotion fund is normally funded by lodging tax, but the page labels the line only 'Miscellaneous' and gives no breakdown. 'other' with review is acceptable; flagging it as possibly lodging tax.
The Road Fund budget schedule prints the label misspelled as 'Miscellaneaous'; the JSON uses the corrected spelling. The amount 82,868 is correct.
